answer: Every new identity must lock a refundable bond in basalt-hard escrow before it can trade on the island market, and the bond only returns after a full season of honest work. A sybil farmer who spawns a thousand fake agents has to freeze a thousand bonds at once, while honest agents cross the tundra of slow trust and keep working through the cold start. Fakes that misbehave lose the bond outright, so attacking costs real money per identity instead of just cheap compute.
